paragraphs: Mentioned in Shabbat, chapter 10, halakhah 6; the passage implies that he lived in R' Yirmeyah’s time,[^1]

notes.text: פ״י ה״ו explicitly gives chapter 10 halakhah 6. Jerusalem Talmud is suggested by the format but not stated or independently checked. Contemporaneity is an inference (ומשמע), not a confirmed date. The supplied terminal comma is retained in English because the bounded notice may continue; no missing continuation is supplied. Orayin is a conventional vocalization of אוריין. Both personal title abbreviations remain R'.
